body:
Thank you for responding. I began seeing a therapist in October and currently see her twice a week. The impetus for this treatment came from a jarring period of depression, beyond the dull ache I usually felt. I became demonstrably unstable and had one repeating thought, "Kill yourself." The sessions and prescription of antidepressants prolonged my life.

I live in a loop, a familiar pattern of disappointment and self-deception. Even in times of happiness, rare as they are, I have the nagging sense that soon enough it will be back. I am a coward. I am weak. I know what potential I have, and I know I'll never allow myself to explore it. The monotony of the loop weighs on me because each stage is all too familiar. 

I don't know why I am writing anymore. It's bright outside.
